C3 AI is hiring an early-career Forward Deployed Engineer for its Federal team. The role designs, develops, and deploys AI-based enterprise applications on the C3 Agentic AI Platform, working directly with U.S. federal customers on demonstrations, proofs-of-technology, trials, and production applications.
